हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: You Got The Wrong Person is a story of a humble new student is mistaken for a poor nobody, she becomes the target of the elite’s cruelty.But Eva has secrets, and she’s not the one they should be underestimating.A fiery school drama where status, lies, and revenge collide.
